article.headline: Rockets visit Nuggets Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.description: Houston Rockets (12-4, third in the Western Conference) vs. Denver Nuggets (8-5, seventh in the Western Conference)
article.title: Rockets visit Nuggets Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.linkText: Rockets visit Nuggets Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.story: Houston Rockets (12-4, third in the Western Conference) vs. Denver Nuggets (8-5, seventh in the Western Conference) Denver; Friday, 10 p.m. EST LINE: Nuggets -3.5; over/under is 227.5 BOTTOM LINE: The Houston Rockets visit the Houston Rockets in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup. The Nuggets are 5-5 in conference games. Denver has a 3-3 record against opponents above .500. The Rockets are 6-3 against Western Conference opponents. Houston ranks fifth in the Western Conference with 45.7 rebounds per game led by Alperen Sengun averaging 9.1. The Nuggets make 48.2% of their shots from the field this season, which is 2.3 percentage points higher than the Rockets have allowed to their opponents (45.9%). The Rockets average 13.1 made 3-pointers per game this season, 0.9 fewer makes per game than the Nuggets give up. The two teams match up for the second time this season. The Rockets defeated the Nuggets 110-100 in their last matchup on Nov. 10. Kevin Durant led the Rockets with 23 points, and Jamal Murray led the Nuggets with 38 points. TOP PERFORMERS: Christian Braun is scoring 12.8 points per game and averaging 4.3 rebounds for the Nuggets. Murray is averaging 26.7 points and 4.9 rebounds over the last 10 games. Sengun is averaging 21.6 points, 9.1 rebounds and 6.8 assists for the Rockets. Durant is averaging 20.1 points over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Nuggets: 7-3, averaging 113.2 points, 41.0 rebounds, 27.2 assists, 8.5 steals and 4.3 blocks per game while shooting 49.0% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 109.4 points per game. Rockets: 7-3, averaging 116.0 points, 45.8 rebounds, 27.4 assists, 5.8 steals and 5.6 blocks per game while shooting 47.1% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 108.7 points. INJURIES: Nuggets: Julian Strawther: out (knee). Rockets: Alperen Sengun: day to day (eye), Clint Capela: day to day (ankle). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
